NHRC Bench Questions FSSAI on Analogue Paneer Production and Sale

A bench of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), led by Priyank Kanoongo, has sought detailed information from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) regarding the manufacture and sale of "analogue paneer." The commission specifically requested details on the safety, ingredients, and labelling practices for this product. This action follows bans on similar products in several Indian states. The NHRC bench is investigating the potential risks associated with analogue paneer, especially after its prohibition elsewhere.
